title: What
description: What outcomes does the effect relate to, and how important are they to the people (or planet) experiencing it?

title: How Much
description: How much of the effect occurs in the time period?

title: Who
description: Who experiences the effect and how underserved are they in relation to the outcome?

title: How
description: How does the effect compare and contribute to what is likely to occur anyway?

title: Which
description: Which risk factors are significant and how likely is it that the outcome is different from the expectation?
